reason: The plugin primarily enables users to share frozen, read-only DeepSeek Harness session snapshots with other devices on the same LAN through tokenized browser URLs.

summaries.zh: 通过局域网令牌链接分享 DeepSeek Harness 会话的只读快照，包括对话内容和会话统计。
summaries.en: Share read-only snapshots of DeepSeek Harness sessions, including conversation content and session statistics, through tokenized LAN URLs.

capabilities: Adds a Share button and dialog to session headers
Creates frozen read-only HTML snapshots of conversations and session statistics
Serves snapshots through a separate LAN HTTP server using tokenized URLs
Persists share records and supports token revocation and optional expiry
